userAdmin.orgManagerHint: May draw the organizational structure and appoint people to positions — typically an HR person. Independent of the role; only an administrator can still DELETE the structure.
userAdmin.orgManagerAutoHint: Nobody is an explicit structure manager, so the administrator covers it automatically. Use the switch to hand it to a specific person.
userAdmin.orgManagerAutoBanner: The administrator currently manages the org structure — until you appoint a specific person with the switch.

aiKredity.heading: AI credits
aiKredity.description: AI assistant usage for the organization and per person, in turns. 1 turn ≈ one ordinary message to the assistant (average of real usage; a long message with a photo or attachment costs more, a short question less). Counted from the assistant chat tokens; work of local models is free; the older AI features in the map are not counted yet.
aiKredity.settingsHint: The quota runs Monday 00:00 UTC to Sunday and does not carry over. Administrators may use the whole quota; their reserve cannot be used up by other members. 100 % = others get nothing, 0 % = no reserve. Quota 0 = no own limit (the operator's cap, if any, still applies).
aiKredity.split: Administrators: {{admin}} reserved, may use up to {{kvota}} · others at most {{ostatni}} credits
aiKredity.envNotice: The operator set a cap of {{kvota}} credits per week. Your own value can only lower it, not raise it.

aiVision.label: The assistant reads images (photos of notes, screenshots)
aiVision.hint: The model must see images (e.g. gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4.1-mini, gemma4). After saving it is tried on a built-in image — images are enabled only when the model actually reads it.
aiVision.notTested: Not verified yet — save the settings or click Test an image.
aiVision.env: Image reading is set by the operator (KB_VISION_* environment variables) — it cannot be changed here.
